style: stylized 3D soft clay, chunky glossy forms, thick rounded silhouette, clean game art
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every sprite that takes part in the mechanic declares its orientation in words (rule C.8): the four bowls say their opening faces UP, the chute says its opening faces DOWN, and the two arrows plus the back chevron are marked asymmetric so they are never mirrored. The two nine sliced sprites (plate, gauge fill) ask for a uniform border and a flat stretchable middle, because their .meta gives them a real spriteBorder. No prompt argues about the background colour - the pipeline cuts it away (rule F.1b). There is no audio asset of any kind (rule C.20), no prompt contains the app name and no sprite carries lettering (hard rule 1): the splash and menu mark is an abstract crown whose points are bowls. The icon hero is one object, the golden bowl with a single plum in it.
